module.description: Project Zomboid dedicated server management module with full lifecycle control

data_home.label: Legacy Data Folder
data_home.description: Data folder detected from the existing server layout. Keeps the current INI folder.

cache_dir.label: Data Folder
cache_dir.description: Where this server keeps its settings, saves and logs (-cachedir). Empty uses ~/Zomboid

server_name.label: Server Profile Name
server_name.description: Name of the server profile (determines INI file name)

admin_password.label: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Default admin account password (set on first launch)

no_steam.label: No Steam Mode
no_steam.description: Run server without Steam (allows GoG players)

public_name.label: Server Name
public_name.description: Name displayed in the server browser

public_description.label: Server Description
public_description.description: Server description visible in the browser

password.label: Server Password
password.description: Password required to join the server (leave empty for none)

port.label: Game Port
port.description: UDP port the game server listens on

udp_port.label: Second UDP Port
udp_port.description: Second UDP port the game server listens on (UDPPort, usually game port + 1)

public.label: Public Visibility
public.description: Show server in the Steam server browser

pause_empty.label: Pause When Empty
pause_empty.description: Pause world when no players are connected

workshop_items.label: Workshop Items
workshop_items.description: Semicolon-separated list of Workshop item IDs

safety_system.label: Safety System
safety_system.description: Let each player turn PvP on or off (requires PVP enabled)

sleep_needed.label: Sleep Needed
sleep_needed.description: Players need to sleep when exhausted

ping_limit.label: Ping Limit
ping_limit.description: Players with a ping above this value (ms) are kicked (100 = disabled)

max_items_for_loot_respawn.label: Loot Respawn Threshold
max_items_for_loot_respawn.description: Max items for loot respawn trigger

safehouse_allow_trespass.label: Safehouse Trespassing
safehouse_allow_trespass.description: Allow players who are not safehouse members to enter

safehouse_allow_loot.label: Safehouse Looting
safehouse_allow_loot.description: Allow players who are not safehouse members to loot

allow_destruction_by_sledgehammer.label: Sledgehammer Destruction
allow_destruction_by_sledgehammer.description: Allow players to destroy structures with a sledgehammer

do_lua_checksum.label: Lua Checksum
do_lua_checksum.description: Check that connected players' Lua files match the server's (disable if using client-side mods)

minutes_per_page.label: Minutes Per Page
minutes_per_page.description: In-game minutes needed to read one page of a book

managed_start.label: Managed Start (Console)
managed_start.description: Start the server through saba-runner so saba-chan can use its console. RCON stays off in every mode. If you turn this off, saba-chan cannot send commands to the server.

graceful_stop.label: Graceful Stop
graceful_stop.description: Send the 'quit' command (saves the world, then exits) and wait for the server to stop. If you turn this off, saba-chan ends the server process at once.

server_welcome_message.label: Welcome Message
server_welcome_message.description: Welcome message displayed to players after connecting (use <LINE> for line breaks)

auto_create_user_in_whitelist.label: Auto-Add to Whitelist
auto_create_user_in_whitelist.description: Automatically add new players to the whitelist when they join

display_user_name.label: Display Username
display_user_name.description: Show player usernames above their heads and in local chat

show_first_and_last_name.label: Show Character Name
show_first_and_last_name.description: Display character's first and last name instead of username

show_safety.label: Show Safety Icon
show_safety.description: Show skull icon when a player has PvP safety toggled off

safety_toggle_timer.label: Safety Toggle Timer
safety_toggle_timer.description: Time in minutes to switch between PvP on and off

safety_cooldown_timer.label: Safety Cooldown Timer
safety_cooldown_timer.description: Time in minutes before PvP safety can be toggled again

pvp_melee_while_hit_reaction.label: PVP Melee While Hit Reaction
pvp_melee_while_hit_reaction.description: Allow melee attacks during hit reaction in PVP

mouse_over_to_see_display_name.label: Mouse Over to See Name
mouse_over_to_see_display_name.description: Require mouse hover to see player display names

hide_players_behind_you.label: Hide Players Behind You
hide_players_behind_you.description: Hide players that are behind your character

player_respawn_with_self.label: Respawn at Death
player_respawn_with_self.description: Allow players to respawn at their place of death

player_respawn_with_other.label: Respawn at Partner
player_respawn_with_other.description: Allow spawning at a splitscreen partner's location

drop_off_whitelist_after_death.label: Remove from Whitelist on Death
drop_off_whitelist_after_death.description: Remove a player from the whitelist if their character dies

chat_streams.label: Chat Streams
chat_streams.description: Comma-separated list of enabled chat streams: s,r,a,w,y,sh,f,all

player_save_on_damage.label: Save on Damage
player_save_on_damage.description: Auto-save when a player takes damage

safehouse_day_survived_to_claim.label: Days to Claim Safehouse
safehouse_day_survived_to_claim.description: Game-world days a player must survive before claiming a safehouse

safehouse_removal_time.label: Safehouse Removal Hours
safehouse_removal_time.description: Real-time hours before inactive members are removed from safehouse

disable_safehouse_when_player_connected.label: Disable Safehouse When Online
disable_safehouse_when_player_connected.description: Disable safehouse protection when any member is connected

faction_day_survived_to_create.label: Days to Create Faction
faction_day_survived_to_create.description: Game-world days a player must survive to create a faction

faction_players_required_for_tag.label: Players for Faction Tag
faction_players_required_for_tag.description: Number of members required to display a faction tag

construction_prevents_loot_respawn.label: Construction Blocks Loot Respawn
construction_prevents_loot_respawn.description: Player constructions near containers prevent loot respawn

hours_for_world_item_removal.label: World Item Removal Hours
hours_for_world_item_removal.description: In-game hours before dropped items/corpses disappear (0 = never)

world_item_removal_list.label: World Item Removal List
world_item_removal_list.description: Comma-separated list of items to auto-remove when placed on ground

blood_splat_lifespan_days.label: Blood Splat Lifespan
blood_splat_lifespan_days.description: Days before blood splats fade away (0 = never)

item_numbers_limit_per_container.label: Item Limit Per Container
item_numbers_limit_per_container.description: Maximum items allowed per container (0 = unlimited)

remove_player_corpses_on_corpse_removal.label: Remove Player Corpses
remove_player_corpses_on_corpse_removal.description: Remove player corpses when corpse cleanup occurs

ping_frequency.label: Ping Frequency
ping_frequency.description: How often the server checks connection to players (seconds)

deny_login_on_overloaded_server.label: Deny Login When Overloaded
deny_login_on_overloaded_server.description: Prevent new connections when server is overloaded

kick_fast_players.label: Kick Speed Hackers
kick_fast_players.description: Kick players moving faster than possible (may be buggy)

steam_scoreboard.label: Steam Scoreboard
steam_scoreboard.description: Show Steam names/avatars in player list (true/false/admin)

upnp.label: UPnP
upnp.description: Enable UPnP for automatic port forwarding

upnp_lease_time.label: UPnP Lease Time
upnp_lease_time.description: UPnP port mapping lease time in seconds

upnp_zero_lease_time_fallback.label: UPnP Zero Lease Fallback
upnp_zero_lease_time_fallback.description: Fall back to zero lease time if specific lease fails

server_browser_announced_ip.label: Announced IP

voice_complexity.description: Opus voice codec complexity (1-10, higher = better quality)

voice_max_distance.label: Voice Max Distance
voice_max_distance.description: Maximum distance for hearing voice chat

discord_channel.label: Discord Channel
discord_channel.description: Discord channel name for server messages

discord_channel_id.label: Discord Channel ID
discord_channel_id.description: Discord channel ID for server messages

disable_radio_staff.label: Disable Radio (Staff)
disable_radio_staff.description: Hide radio frequency for staff members

disable_radio_gm.label: Disable Radio (GM)
disable_radio_gm.description: Hide radio frequency for game masters

disable_radio_invisible.label: Disable Radio (Invisible)
disable_radio_invisible.description: Hide radio frequency for invisible players

client_command_filter.label: Client Command Filter
client_command_filter.description: Filter rules for client commands (prefix + to allow, - to deny)

zombie_update_max_high_priority.label: Zombie Max High Priority Updates
zombie_update_max_high_priority.description: Maximum number of high-priority zombie updates per tick

ban_kick_global_sound.label: Ban/Kick Sound
ban_kick_global_sound.description: Play a global sound when a player is banned or kicked

servermsg.label: Announce
servermsg.description: Broadcast a message to all connected players

kick.label: Kick Player
kick.description: Kick a player from the server

banuser.label: Ban Player
banuser.description: Ban a player from the server

adduser.label: Add User
adduser.description: Add a new user to the server

teleport.label: Teleport
teleport.description: Teleport a player to another player

createhorde.label: Create Horde
createhorde.description: Spawn a zombie horde near a player

invisible.label: Invisible

additem.label: Give Item

errors.backup_paths_failed: Could not read the save folder for backup: {{error}}
errors.graceful_stop_unavailable: There is no way to ask the server to save and exit (no console or REST). It was not stopped. Force stop it only if you accept losing unsaved progress.

errors.connection_refused: Cannot connect to the server. Please check that the server is running and the port is correct.
errors.timeout: Server response timed out. Please check the server status.
errors.admin_password_required: The first launch needs an admin password. Without one the server stops and waits for it in the console.
errors.no_server_dir: Server installation directory not found. Please set the server executable path.
errors.executable_not_found: Server executable (StartServer64.bat or start-server.sh) not found in the server directory.
errors.java_not_found: Could not find bundled Java (jre64/bin/java). The server installation may be incomplete.
errors.classpath_not_found: Could not find Java class files (java/*.jar) in the server directory. The installation may be incomplete.
errors.no_install_dir: No installation directory specified. Please set a working directory.
errors.steamcmd_not_found: SteamCMD not found. Please install SteamCMD to download the server.
errors.install_timeout: Server installation did not finish within 10 minutes.
errors.server_not_running: Server is not running. Please start the server first.
errors.server_reset_partial: Some items could not be deleted: {{errors}}
errors.invalid_server_name: This server name cannot be used: {{name}}. Use a name without folder separators (/ \), ':' or '..' that does not end with a space or dot
errors.extension_not_enabled: SteamCMD extension is not enabled. Enable it in Settings → Extensions first.

detect.port_in_use: Port {{port}} is already in use by another application
detect.illegal_termination: Illegal termination of worker thread (possible Build 41/42 conflict)
detect.permission_denied: Permission denied. Cannot access required files
detect.mod_error: A mod error was detected in the server log

solutions.admin_password_required: Enter an admin password in the server settings, then start again.
solutions.no_server_dir: Set the path to your server executable (StartServer64.bat) in instance settings, or install the server via SteamCMD.
solutions.executable_not_found: Download the server via SteamCMD (App ID 380870) or through Steam. Navigate to the install directory and verify StartServer64.bat exists.
solutions.java_not_found: The server should include a bundled JRE. Try reinstalling the server or verifying file integrity via SteamCMD.
solutions.classpath_not_found: The java/ directory in the server folder should contain .jar files. Try verifying the installation via SteamCMD.
solutions.out_of_memory: Increase the RAM allocation in server settings (Memory). Default is 4 GB; try 8 GB or more for larger servers.
solutions.port_in_use: Port {{port}} is in use. Stop the conflicting application or change the port in settings.
solutions.illegal_termination: This usually happens when upgrading from Build 41 to 42. Back up your settings and delete the %USERPROFILE%\Zomboid folder, then restart the server.
solutions.permission_denied: Run saba-chan as administrator, or change file permissions to allow read/write access to the server and data directories.
solutions.server_crash: Check the console.txt log for details. Common causes: mod conflicts, corrupted world data, or insufficient memory.
solutions.mod_error: A mod is causing errors. Try disabling recently added mods or check the Workshop page for compatibility updates.
solutions.save_status: This is informational. If saves are failing, check disk space and file permissions.
solutions.steamcmd_not_found: Install SteamCMD from https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/SteamCMD and ensure it's in your PATH.
